items.title: Work of Marshall Nirenberg, Philip Leder and Har Gobind Khorana (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Work of Marshall Nirenberg, Philip Leder and Har Gobind Khorana: a main subheading of 19.4.1 Genetic Code, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 131-132.

blocks.text: 1961 mein American biochemist Marshall Nirenberg ne poly-U mRNA banaya, yaani aisa mRNA jis mein sirf uracil nucleotides the. Us ne yeh mRNA bacteria ke cytoplasm mein daala to bacteria ne aisa polypeptide banaya jis mein bohat se phenylalanine amino acids the. Us ne nateeja nikala ke codon UUU phenylalanine ka code hai. Nirenberg aur aik aur American geneticist Philip Leder ne saare triplet codons test kiye aur 47 codons ke amino acids maloom kiye. Har Gobind Khorana (jinhon ne Government College, Lahore se taleem mukammal ki) ne baqi 17 triplet codons ke amino acids maloom kiye.

Kul 64 codons mein se teen codons (UGA, UAG aur UAA) stop codons ya nonsense codons hain. Agar in mein se koi mRNA ke aakhir mein ho to woh koi amino acid tay nahin karta aur protein banna rok deta hai. Codon AUG start codon ka kaam karta hai; yeh har genetic code ke shuru mein hota hai aur amino acid methionine tay karta hai.

1968 ka Physiology & Medicine ka Nobel Prize Nirenberg (genetic code par kaam), Har Gobind Khorana (nucleic acids banana) aur Robert Holley (transfer-RNA ki kimiyai banawat daryaft karna) ko diya gaya.

blocks.alt: Teen drawings saath saath. Baen: Marshall Nirenberg laboratory mein, kaale baal, safed lab coat aur gehri tie, haath mein pipette aur tube, peeche botalon ke shelf. Beech: Philip Leder chalkboard ke saamne jis par chalk ke khaake hain, kaale baal, safed shirt, haath jore hue. Daen: Har Gobind Khorana, surmai baal aur moti kaali ainak, gulabi shirt, notes se bhare board par likhte hue.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein in tasveeron ke caption par “Marshal Nirenberg” chhapa hai. Sahi naam Marshall Nirenberg hai, jaisa kitab ke text aur heading mein hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar DNA (template strand) ka triplet AAA ho to mRNA codon kya hoga aur woh kaun sa amino acid tay karega?
blocks.explanation: mRNA codon UUU hoga (A ke saamne U), jo phenylalanine ka code hai; yahi Nirenberg ke poly-U tajarbe ka nateeja tha.

items: Crick (1961): codon 3 nucleotides ka; 4 × 4 × 4 = 64 codons, 20 amino acids ke liye kaafi.
Nirenberg: UUU = phenylalanine; Nirenberg aur Leder ne 47 codons, Khorana ne baqi 17 maloom kiye.
AUG start codon (methionine); UAA, UAG, UGA stop codons.
